action: Update Tails to 7.17.1; restarting Tails deletes any malicious uBlock Origin configuration. Tails says uBlock Origin will be re-added as soon as possible.
exec: A privacy-focused operating system pulled a widely used extension, showing how a browser add-on flaw can undermine anonymity tooling.
plain: Tails removed the uBlock Origin ad blocker in an emergency update because of a serious cross-site scripting flaw. Tails says it knows of no use in attacks so far.
summary: On 17 November 2026 the Tails developers released 7.17.1 as an emergency release that temporarily removes uBlock Origin because of a critical one-click universal XSS flaw. They say a website could insert JavaScript into other sites and that the attack is relatively easy; they know of no real-world use so far. Tor Browser's Standard and Safer levels are affected, Safest is not.
title: Tails removes uBlock Origin in emergency release 7.17.1 over critical XSS flaw

validation.note: Tor Project blog (Tails) and Security.nl both state the core facts.

review.note: Compared date 17 Nov, critical one-click universal XSS, no known real-world use, Standard/Safer affected, restart behaviour against Tails blog and Security.nl
